verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server. It works with MCP-capable AI clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot and Windsurf, and lets an agent manage flags and AgentControl configs and view observability data in natural language; a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in real use, and detail on its tool surface and authentication in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Configure the hosted MCP server so you can manage feature flags and AgentControl configs, and view observability data, directly from your AI client.
you must have an AI client that supports MCP, such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf.
you enable the server, then use it to manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language.
